site.title: Check this site
site.text: What this site’s policy holds that this version doesn’t read, or reads otherwise, the addresses it names, and how the server sends each file. Nothing leaves this browser but, when you ask, a request to each of those addresses.
site.unnamed: index.html names no policy: this is the open version, with nothing set by an organisation.
site.missing: index.html names {file}, which the server doesn’t send ({status}).
site.chosen: {file}, chosen here, checked against this site.
site.fine: Every part is one this version reads, in the shape it reads it.
site.unreadNear: Not read by this version. Did you mean {name}?
site.object: Should be a group of settings, in { }.
site.https: Not an https address: browsers refuse plain http, except to this computer.
site.refused: This site’s Content-Security-Policy header refuses it.
site.unreached: No answer this site may read: down, out of reach from here, or not allowing this site (CORS).
site.key: The key unlocks this version here for {organisation}, until {date}.
site.trial: The trial key unlocks this version here for {organisation}, until {date}.
site.local: No key is needed on this computer.
site.keyless: These parts need a key that unlocks this version here, or everyone gets a message for IT in its place:
